formula: GHI = (IR counts - dark floor) * (a + b * (1 - mu)), mu = hourly mean cos(solar zenith)
reference: ERA5 hourly shortwave radiation, Open-Meteo archive API (models=era5), grid -1.0, 37.0

provenance.fitted_by: conduit-app/src/joto_guard/solar_calibration.py, least squares on hourly means of the organiser one-minute exports
provenance.held_out_method: each of the 10 days left out of the fit in turn and predicted
provenance.not_refitted_here: values are copied unchanged; refitting belongs to the Python project that owns the reference join
